request.style: English, Celtic folk duet, male and female vocals, Celtic harp, fiddle, uilleann pipes, acoustic guitar, bodhran, flowing like a river, 90 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Down to the Jordan the Son of God came walking
John held him in the water as the river rolled along
As soon as Jesus was baptized, he came up out of the water
And behold, a voice from heaven said
This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased

[Chorus]
So through baptism we were buried with him into death
In order that, just as Christ was raised from the dead
By the glory of the Father
We too might walk in newness of life

[Verse]
On the desert road from Jerusalem a chariot was turning
Philip told the good news about Jesus as they rode
Look, here is water
What is to keep me from being baptized
And he went on his way rejoicing down the road

[Chorus]
So through baptism we were buried with him into death
In order that, just as Christ was raised from the dead
By the glory of the Father
We too might walk in newness of life

[Bridge]
Go and make disciples of all nations
Baptizing them in the name of the Father
And of the Son and of the Holy Spirit
And remember, I am with you always
To the very end of the age

[Outro]
We too might walk in newness of life
Newness of life
